commit.message:
Fix permission-denied install error on 100 already-published packages

Every .ipk/.deb the auto-publish pipeline had built before this fix
shipped CONTROL/{preinst,postinst,prerm,postrm} as non-executable
(644), which opkg/dpkg reject at install time since they exec() these
scripts directly. Rebuilt each affected package's control archive
with correct permissions (755 on maintainer scripts, 644 on control)
using the real ar/tar tools; data.tar.* is untouched and verified
byte-identical to before.

Fix permission-denied install error: chmod maintainer scripts

CONTROL/{preinst,postinst,prerm,postrm} were being tarred with
whatever permission bits the source repo's git checkout happened to
have, which is often 644 (no exec bit) since git doesn't require
these to be marked executable. opkg/dpkg exec() these scripts
directly, so a non-executable script fails the install with
"permission denied". Force 755 on the maintainer scripts and 644 on
control before packaging, on a staged copy rather than mutating the
source checkout.

Bump Lotto Statistiche to v1.2

Updated the addon manifest to point to the new Lotto Statistiche v1.2 package and replaced the old v1.1 .ipk with the new release.
